name: Stored cross-site scripting
mental_model: Untrusted content survives a storage boundary and is later interpreted as executable content for a viewer.
security_property: Persisted untrusted content must remain data whenever it is rendered, regardless of who views it.
root_causes: Encoding on input instead of at the eventual output context
Unsafe rendering of stored user-controlled content
signals: A controlled marker persists across requests
Stored content is rendered to another controlled view
The render path uses an executable context

hypothesis_templates.statement: When {actor} stores {marker} through {storage_surface}, {viewer} may later receive it in {sink} without context-appropriate encoding.
preconditions: Both producer and viewer identities are controlled
Storage and render surfaces are explicitly in scope
hypothesis_templates.expected_safe_behaviour: Stored content is encoded for the viewer's output context.
hypothesis_templates.expected_vulnerable_behaviour: Stored untrusted content reaches an executable viewer context.
hypothesis_templates.falsifier: The value is rejected, normalised safely, or encoded at every reachable render path.
stop_conditions: The marker becomes visible to an uncontrolled user
The path reaches messaging or notification systems

safe_test_pattern: Store one inert marker in a synthetic record, view it only through a second controlled identity, record both controls, then remove the record.
positive_controls: Trusted stored content renders normally to the controlled viewer
negative_controls: The untrusted stored marker renders inert after output encoding
falsifiers: All reachable render contexts keep the marker inert

minimum_evidence.description: Storage receipt and controlled viewer render observation for the same marker.
Ownership and viewer records proving only controlled identities were involved.
Encoded render negative control and trusted-content positive control.
Clean synthetic record repeated and removed under the same render path.
Human statement bounded to the controlled viewer and demonstrated render context.

common_false_positives: The marker is stored but escaped at render time
Only a privileged self-view is affected
A preview differs from the persisted viewer path
impact_boundaries: Persistence does not prove another user's exposure
Controlled rendering does not prove credential or account compromise
minimum_impact_rules: Use only synthetic records and owned identities
Delete the marker after the test
Do not trigger email, notification, or third-party review surfaces
remediation: Review every downstream render path for the stored field
programme_policy_considerations: Avoid support, moderation, and other staff-facing surfaces

revisions.summary: Initial persistent-render card with controlled two-viewer fixture.
